messages.subject: problem using R/ASMap
parts:
Hello
I'm currently mapping for my research a F2 cross using the R/ASMap package and R/qtl too. I have 150 individuals and 670 markers. I encountered a problem running droponemarker(), as it uses est.map() rather than quickEst(). The differences are shown below. (pos(quickEst) is from mstmap())

marker name   pos(est.map)     LOD              Ldiff             chr      pos(quickEst)      chrlen
m230394         1851.617           21.027196    43.60392      L.1      351.9984             712.3529

droponemarker() analysis is irrelevant if the calculation is based on a different algorithm.
please help 

thank's!
Nataly SImhayev
M.Sc student
Bar Ilan University, Ramat-Gan, Israel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] problem using R/ASMap
parts:
Contact the authors if ASMap for help with that package. 

The R/qtl function droponemarker() does use its own est.map() function.

karl
